findings.description: AC1 / the codex launcher test used a presence-only regex, which would pass even if the title-set line were placed AFTER the blocking `& codex` invocation (where it never runs) — the same false-positive class as the v2.2.0/v3.1.1 wt rename-tab bug. Flagged High by codex and copilot, Low by claude.
findings.resolution: AC1 and the tests/codex-engine-field.test.js bullet now MANDATE an ordering assertion (titleSetLine index < script.search(/^& codex /m)) in addition to the value-presence assertion.

findings.description: Plan file paths are plugin-relative; from the plan worktree root they do not resolve (the ai-developer-toolkit submodule is uninitialized). An implementer could edit the codexu ROOT AGENTS.md/CHANGELOG instead of the plugin ones.
findings.resolution: Added a 'Target repo / working directory (READ FIRST)' note: all paths are relative to ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/crews/; impl targets that submodule; edit the PLUGIN AGENTS.md/CHANGELOG, never the codexu root AGENTS.md or gitignored CLAUDE.md.
findings.suggestedFix: State the submodule target + init requirement explicitly in the plan.

findings.description: AC2 claimed copilot/claude launchers stay 'byte-identical' but the suggested regression test only asserts absence of `$Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle`. If the impl chooses a fallback mechanism ([Console]::Title / OSC), AC2 would not protect against it; and a single-line-absence test cannot prove literal byte-identity. Flagged High by copilot, Medium by codex.
findings.resolution: AC2 reworded to 'no codex title-set line + no behavior-relevant change' (not literal byte-identity), and made mechanism-neutral: assert absence of the CHOSEN mechanism string. Also requires BOTH copilot and claude to each have an absence assertion (folds in claude's F-006).
findings.suggestedFix: Assert absence of the chosen mechanism for both copilot and claude scripts.

findings.description: AC5 wording ('all 6 version files + the 3 marketplace indexes') reads like 9 files; the 3 marketplace indexes are PART of the 6 stamp files. Flagged Medium by codex and copilot.
findings.resolution: AC5 clarified: bump-version.js updates exactly SIX stamp files (3 plugin manifests + 3 marketplace indexes) plus tests/version.test.js; the marketplace indexes are part of the six, not additional.
findings.suggestedFix: Reword AC5 to the 6-stamp-files + version.test.js shape.

findings.description: AC7 (manual live smoke) does not specify where the live result is recorded, so later reviewers cannot distinguish 'not automatable' from 'not performed.'
findings.resolution: AC7 now requires recording the live-smoke outcome (pass/fail + chosen mechanism + observations) in the impl member's kind=done report AND the AGENTS.md v3.x note / ship notes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a durable-record requirement to AC7.

findings.description: AC2's 'and/or' phrasing between the two candidate test files left it ambiguous whether both copilot and claude must be asserted; an impl could assert only one engine and still argue AC2 is met.
findings.resolution: Folded into the F-003 AC2 rewrite: AC2 now explicitly requires BOTH copilot AND claude to each have an absence assertion (each in at least one test file).
